title: Freeze transaction entry
instruction: Lock subledgers and prevent late postings.

title: Extract trial balance and feed timestamps
instruction: Extract the trial balance and source-system timestamps.

title: Reconcile material accounts
instruction: Reconcile material accounts and attach evidence.

title: Classify and investigate variances
instruction: Use AI triage, then apply human situated judgment to material or anomalous variances.

title: Controller review
instruction: Independently review reconciliations, evidence, and unresolved items.

title: CFO approval
instruction: Approve the close package or return it with required corrections.

title: Post close and publish package
instruction: Post approved entries and publish the reporting package.

title: Archive evidence and hold retrospective
instruction: Archive evidence and capture questions, issues, and lessons learned.

title: Inspect belt and roller wear
instruction: Inspect the belt.

title: Lock out the line
instruction: Run the lockout procedure.

title: Replace worn rollers
instruction: Replace rollers.

title: Build the release candidate
instruction: Build and test the candidate.

title: Classify change risk
instruction: Score the change's risk class.

title: Release approval gate
instruction: Approve or reject the release using the risk class and test results.

title: Roll out to production
instruction: Roll the approved candidate out.

title: Verify production health
instruction: Check health signals for thirty minutes.

title: Prepare the work order and identify energy sources
instruction: Confirm the work order and list every energy source on the machine.
description: Uses the isolation map for the machine being serviced.

title: Notify affected employees
instruction: Tell operators and nearby staff the machine is going down.

title: Shut the equipment down
instruction: Stop the machine through its normal controls.

title: Isolate every energy source
instruction: Isolate each energy source in turn.

title: Open and lock the electrical disconnect
instruction: Open the main disconnect and fit the breaker lockout.

title: Close and bleed the pneumatic supply
instruction: Close the supply valve, fit the valve lockout and bleed the line.

title: Block raised sections against gravity
instruction: Lower or block every raised conveyor section.

title: Apply personal locks and tags
instruction: Each person working on the machine applies their own lock and tag.

title: Verify the zero-energy state
instruction: Read every gauge and try the start button; nothing may move or hiss.

title: Perform the maintenance
instruction: Carry out the work order.

title: Remove locks and restore energy
instruction: Each person removes only their own lock, then energy is restored.

title: Escalate residual energy and re-isolate
instruction: Keep locks on, escalate to the safety officer and re-isolate.

title: Shut down the machine
instruction: Stop the machine.

title: Apply locks
instruction: Put locks on.

title: Disconnect power
instruction: Cut main power.

title: Do the maintenance
instruction: Do the work.

title: Identify policy trigger and affected population
instruction: Establish the legal/business trigger and population affected.

title: Elicit process and practitioner knowledge
instruction: Interview practitioners, inspect source artifacts, and record tacit/implicit/explicit knowledge.

title: Draft policy and channel variants
instruction: Draft the policy and proposed email/SMS variants from approved sources.

title: Legal and privacy review
instruction: Review legal commitments, privacy, consent, retention, and jurisdictional requirements.

title: Human authority approval
instruction: Approve the policy meaning and all channel constraints.

title: Generate approved communications
instruction: Render approved email and SMS messages without changing policy meaning.

title: Apply channel controls and send
instruction: Enforce consent, quiet hours, opt-out text, recipient scope, and delivery logging.

title: Collect acknowledgements and exceptions
instruction: Collect acknowledgements and create exception tasks for unreachable recipients.

title: Review feedback and update knowledge
instruction: Review questions, feedback, delivery failures, and proposed knowledge changes.
